questions.question: Why is a web crawl snapshot not yet a training dataset?
options: It still needs permission, extraction, quality, privacy, deduplication, contamination, mixture, and lineage decisions
It contains no machine-readable content
It cannot be stored in object storage
It must be converted into labeled classification examples first
questions.explanation: Collection only establishes an upstream source. A training corpus is the versioned result of governance and curation decisions.

questions.question: A coding copilot corpus has 45% code, 25% web, 15% reference, and 15% governed data. How many billion code tokens are present in a one-trillion-token mixture?
options: 45 billion
150 billion
450 billion
550 billion
questions.explanation: One trillion tokens is 1,000 billion; 45% of 1,000 billion is 450 billion.

questions.question: When is WARC preferable to WET?
options: When raw responses, headers, extraction control, or non-text payloads are required
When only pre-extracted plaintext is needed
When all provenance metadata must be discarded
When duplicate detection must be skipped
questions.explanation: WARC preserves the raw crawl exchange. WET is convenient plaintext produced by an earlier extraction step.

questions.question: Why should a team review both accepted and rejected samples for every important language or source slice?
options: Aggregate acceptance counts can hide systematic false acceptance and false rejection
It guarantees every source has equal token weight
It removes the need for versioned thresholds
It proves the source license is valid
questions.explanation: Slice-level review reveals who or what a threshold removes, which a single corpus-wide rate cannot show.

questions.question: Lowering a near-duplicate similarity threshold usually makes deduplication more aggressive. What must be checked before adopting it?
options: Whether it removes legitimate templates, translations, or rare variants as well as duplicates
Whether it increases raw crawl size
Whether it converts WET files back into WARC files
Whether it eliminates the need for evaluation decontamination
questions.explanation: Broader matching can reduce repeated exposure, but it can also merge distinct documents that share common structure.

questions.question: What ordering best protects benchmark integrity?
options: Reserve evaluation content, remove exact and reviewed near-matches, then finalize the training split
Train first, then delete benchmark URLs from the source list
Publish the corpus, then choose private evaluation sets from it
Use quality filtering as a substitute for overlap detection
questions.explanation: The evaluation inventory must exist before the training split is frozen so overlaps can be removed from all derived copies.

questions.question: Which manifest invariant gives the strongest audit trail?
options: Every accepted document maps to a registered source snapshot and versioned curation decisions
Every source contributes the same number of documents
Every document receives a quality score above 90
Every snapshot is retained forever
questions.explanation: Lineage connects the released corpus to origin and decisions, enabling reproduction, review, and deletion workflows.
